topComment.text: 10:19 Great point. A lot of people glaze Dan Houser and act like he single-handedly made everything Rockstar is known for, when there were several other talented writers and developers behind those games. Some of the original co-writers and longtime employees are still at Rockstar, including Rupert Humphries. You also have the three major development leads at Rockstar North: Rob Nelson, Aaron Garbut, and Phil Hooker. And let’s not forget Sam Houser, who’s still the president of Rockstar Games and remains heavily involved in the creative direction of GTA 6. Dan was undoubtedly a huge part of Rockstar’s success, but acting like everything revolved around him completely discredits the hundreds of other people who helped build these games.
